verdict.rationale:
Portkey documents virtual API keys per provider/org (portkey-docs-9, portkey-docs-41) combined with configurable budget limits and rate limits per API key that auto-block further usage when exceeded (portkey-docs-13, portkey-docs-25, portkey-docs-38, portkey-docs-35), directly enabling issuing a scoped key to an autonomous agent with spend/rate guardrails. Fine-grained budgets/rate-limits/model allow-lists at org and workspace level (portkey-docs-33) further support per-agent governance.

missing for 10: no explicit agent-specific walkthrough (e.g., 'issue a key to an agent') and no independent/hands-on confirmation that limits reliably stop runaway agent spend in practice.
